Alger, 3 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 3, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Faced with the rise in respiratory infections, Dr. Tayeb Hamdi is warning about the severe cardiovascular complications of the flu. He recommends preventive vaccination starting in the fall, particularly for vulnerable populations and healthcare workers.
Chaque année, la grippe saisonnière affe: Each year, seasonal flu affects approximately one billion individuals worldwide, causing more than five million severe cases and up to 650,000 deaths. Far from being a simple cold, this condition manifests as a sudden fever between 38 °C and 40 °C, a dry cough, and intense exhaustion.
Au-delà des atteintes respiratoires, le: Beyond respiratory damage, the virus triggers an inflammatory shock that significantly increases cardiovascular conditions. In the seven days following contamination, the risk of myocardial infarction is multiplied by ten, and remains six times higher during the subsequent three months. In addition, the probability of suffering a stroke increases eightfold in the month following infection, while heart failure rises by 20%.
La vaccination constitue la protection p: Vaccination is the primary protection, recommended starting at the age of six months. It has a safety profile established by eight decades of use and is particularly crucial for vulnerable individuals, such as seniors over 65, young children, pregnant women, and subjects with chronic illnesses like diabetes or hypertension.

Children under five account for about 30% of hospitalizations for severe respiratory infections, compared to 55% for adults over 50 or those suffering from comorbidities. Since the vaccine takes about two weeks to work, the period of October and November is recommended for getting vaccinated before the peak of infections.
